laravel_baseline: Laravel 13.x stable documentation (bundle catalogue: 111 seed rows; 133-row official-domain register; baseline currency NOT re-verified in this environment - no live documentation fetch)

evidence: RAW-EVIDENCE/demo-boot.stderr: thread 'main' (7924) has overflowed its stack
RAW-EVIDENCE/demo-call.stderr: the same overflow in the one-shot --call path
RAW-EVIDENCE/kelson-graph.out: kelson graph exits 0 (6 modules, 14 operations)
RAW-EVIDENCE/kelson-route-list.out: kelson route:list exits 0
gates.notes: The in-process router is proven (101 demo HTTP cases green), but the real server path cannot start: the reference host aborts during boot. The graph and the route plan are not implicated.

evidence: the_credential_abilities_narrow_the_decision (kelson-policy)
a_personal_access_token_is_confined_to_its_abilities (demo, live: 200 for the granted capability, 403 outside it)
the tenant_isolation_* cases across the queue, the events, the cache and the storage
gates.notes: Scoped to the auth surfaces that are named. The RLS half of the database gate is separate.

evidence: PostgreSQL 5433 not reachable on this host (the known 0xC0000142 native fault)
the atlas's P0 'real PostgreSQL integration' case is a silent self-skip in every run
gates.notes: Environment block, not a code defect. The RLS assertion is also unnamed (LF-089).

evidence: MySQL: 3307 not reachable (the portable instance's mysqld binary is gone; the system instance on 3306 denies the keel user)
Redis: reachable (restarted by the audit on 6379)
gates.notes: The live-MySQL matrix could not be executed in this pass; the Redis half was available.

evidence: the host does not boot (GATE-ROUTE-DISPATCH-E2E), so no activation experiment can be run
gates.notes: The machinery (the 500ms config poller, the route reloader, the flag reloader) exists and is tracked; the process-level experiment has never run.

evidence: docs/P0-EXECUTION-REPORT.md Phase 1: NOT RUN (infrastructure limitation)
the boot that would carry the experiment aborts
gates.notes: The flagship promise has no evidence. See KFA-009.

evidence: the Secret type: UTF-8 validated at construction, a redacted Debug, a wiped Drop, a constant-time eq_ct
config_show_renders_one_redacted_section; env_summary_reports_environment_secrets_and_cache_state
gates.notes: Proven per surface; the coverage is per-surface rather than systematic.

evidence: cargo deny check: advisories FAILED, bans FAILED, licenses ok, sources ok
cargo audit: 10 advisories, 3 critical (wasmtime x3, rustls x4, webpki-roots, rustls-webpki, rsa)
the SBOM/provenance generators exist in the working tree but are UNTRACKED
gates.notes: The dependency policy gate fails on the advisories, and the provenance tooling is not under version control.

evidence: docker: ABSENT in this environment
the host does not boot (GATE-ROUTE-DISPATCH-E2E)
gates.notes: No container build, no clean-room start, no health/shutdown drill was possible.

evidence: the promotion lock and the rollback executor are green (a_second_promotion_is_refused_while_the_lock_is_held, the_file_lock_admits_one_holder_and_releases_on_drop, an_expired_lease_can_be_broken_but_a_live_one_may_not)
the outbox's PostgreSQL half: NOT_RUN
gates.notes: The rollback machinery is proven; the durable-store half is not, and the host cannot start.

evidence: the metrics, the traces and the incident plane exist (the observability suite is green)
the metric cardinality limits, the sensitive labels and the retention are unnamed (LF-100)
gates.notes: The instrumentation is there; the bounds that make it safe to expose are not proven.
Seven findings at S0/S1 remain open in the release scope.

limitations: PostgreSQL unavailable (the native fault 0xC0000142): every pg-only case self-skipped
MySQL 3307 unavailable (the portable instance's binary is gone); the system instance's credentials are unknown
No Docker daemon: no container build, no clean-room deploy, no SBOM/signature artefact
No browser: the Playwright e2e specs have never been executed
The Laravel 13.x documentation baseline was NOT re-fetched in this environment: the catalogue is historical input

The whole-workspace coverage measurement FAILED with LNK1318 (the disk was at 0 bytes free; the instrumented build needs a second target tree). A scoped measurement over 4 of the 84 crates succeeded: 89.07% regions, 86.23% functions, 88.38% lines (RAW-EVIDENCE/coverage-summary.txt)
